proposed.sourceName: LPPOM MUI (Majelis Ulama Indonesia) — Halal Assurance System HAS 23000 & MUI Fatwa No. 10/2018 on ethanol
proposed.paraphrase: MUI's HAS 23000 requires Muslim slaughter with the name of Allah and fully halal-verified materials, and Fatwa 10/2018 forbids khamr-derived ethanol and classes any drink with ≥0.5% ethanol as khamr (haram) — meeting the hanafi-strict bar on alcohol/additive strictness. (Seafood caveat: MUI follows the Shafi'i view permitting all seafood, an axis the app's hanafi-strict flags but does not currently enforce in the grade matrix.)

researcherNote: MUI permits manual OR mechanical slaughter with reversible stunning → correctly NOT mapped to zabiha. hanafiStrict rests on MUI's strict alcohol/najs standard; seafood axis is a known unenforced carried gap (flagged). APPROVED by owner 2026-07-01 (batch pre-approval).
